## **Bugs and stability** {#theme-bugs_stability}

   **Bugs and stability.**
      2 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: May 17, 2026 - Jul 25, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users report reliability problems. This points to quality gaps competitors can exploit.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _jkaonw_, Jul 25, 2026, 1/5: "You will never make money with this app, the miners get very slow over a couple of months and then become unprofitable so they literally just do nothing. DO NOT BUY A MINER ON THIS APP"
            2. _MLGamer25_, Jul 8, 2026, 1/5: "I’ve been a part of this after for around four months now. And I absolutely cannot recommend it to anybody. I have had so many issues consistently for the past four months with absolutely zero resolution or compensation from the support team. The free, bonus miner you’re supposed to be able to claim. I never got because of some kind on their end and now they refused to compensate me for. The other free bonus miner literally requires you giving them your passport to claim it. Not to mention the numerous bugs and glitches when it comes to the market where you can buy and sell miners from other people. Not only that they have consistently made update that only people that invest with this app. They removed the ability to transfer your response and now every single transfer requires payment. Already drained your money at every possible point with tons of hidden fees and now you can’t even move around the money that’s supposed to be yours without them taking more. If you’re reading this review, I beg of you to not get roped into this like I did. I know it seems like easy money overtime, but the miners you purchase literally become useless overtime with bitcoin halving. Steer clear away from this app."
            3. _olive77777771_, May 17, 2026, 1/5: "We can understand that there is a Bug from time to time but not that the website and the application are inaccessible for days"
